text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Belt isn't twisted.
Waist cord is securely tied.
Alright, perfect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Calstone Light O was doing maintenance
on her racing outfit to make sure it was in
perfect condition.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My jacket is sparkling clean too.
I ironed it straight over and over again.
choice_data_list: You've taken great care of it, haven't you?
You've taken great care of it, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
"I want to reach top speed together with this racing outfit."
That's the feeling I poured into its design.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When it was finished, I was in high spirits the entire time.
It turned out exactly as I had envisioned—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Straightforward like my father! Sparkling like my mother!
...That was what my racing silks were like.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It was my parents' influence that led me to pursue top speed.
And the reason for that is...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be faster to just have you meet my parents.
I'll call them. Let me arrange their flight—"
choice_data_list: Wah! You don't have to go that far!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, as I was taking a break between tasks,
Calstone Light O came by.
She said there was something she wanted me to see right away.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's a family photo album.
When I asked my parents, they sent it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the album's photos, there was a young girl, along with a man in a suit and a woman in a lab coat.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this photo...
It's from when I took a picture of Father leaving for work.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
He was a prosecutor.
He never compromised on his beliefs.
My father was deeply dedicated to his work.

text_block_list.name: Young Right O
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, isn't today Sunday?
Daddy, do you have to work?"

text_block_list.name: Right O's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Sorry.
But today's an important interrogation day.

text_block_list.name: Right O's Father
text_block_list.text:
If Dad gives it his all,
maybe he can prove the truth.
...Will you wait for me, Light O, even if it gets lonely?

text_block_list.name: Young Right O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm okay!
Mommy and I are gonna eat parfaits later anyway~ ♪
I don't need Daddy here at all!

text_block_list.name: Right O's Father
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
...O-Oh, okay. Well, I'm off then...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...A person who devoted all her strength for the sake of her justice.
That is the kind of person she was."
choice_data_list: Show that you miss them a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is a photo of my mother.
It was taken to commemorate her paper being accepted.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My mother is a scientist who studies light.
A phenomenon we have yet to fully unravel...
She wishes to open the door to that unknown—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Yes, my mother, pursuing her dreams through research... She looked so radiant and dazzling to me."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, she often grumbled about research funds being low
whenever she had a few drinks, though."
choice_data_list: You didn't have to say that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...However, she must truly be proud of her parents.
The young Calstone Light O in the photo is looking at the two of them with eyes full of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Watching my mother and father, somewhere along the way, I began to think...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Just like those two,
I want to face my own dream.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Those very feelings are what's engraved into that racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A navy jacket inspired by my father's suits.
Just like him, I want to stay true to my convictions.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And a design motif of light.
Just like Mother,
I want to pursue an endless goal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I want to reach 'top speed' in that racing attire. Going straight, shining brilliantly."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I was little,
I've looked up to both of them."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to pursue my dream head-on.
And that wish is only possible because of my mother and father.
choice_data_list: You learned something truly important from your parents.
You learned something truly important from your parents.
Have you been chasing that dream since you were a kid?
Have you been chasing that dream since you were a child?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to pursue my dream head-on.
And that wish is only possible because of my mother and father.
choice_data_list: You learned something truly important from your parents.
You learned something truly important from your parents.
Have you been chasing that dream since you were a kid?
Have you been chasing that dream since you were a child?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
I watched my parents do it all the time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
For example,
Mother only acts spoiled around Father when they're alone.
There was even a time she asked him to be her arm pillow.
choice_data_list: Please keep that a secret just within the family...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Growing into such an honest and sincere Umamusume
must be thanks to her parents...
That was what crossed my mind."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For example, this photo.
Here's a younger me, completely soaked.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was training on the riverbank.
I chased pure speed and kept accelerating, so I ended up diving straight into the river.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There are other ones too.
This photo here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing her dreams since she was young.
Together, we looked through photos
of Calstone Light O's childhood.
